systems.system: Remote education through the National Distance Education Office
systems.country_label: National Distance Education Office; TV7 broadcasts; MOOCs for higher education
systems.tiers: not stated; the report says Algeria prioritises remote education through the office, with TV7 broadcasts and, for higher education, MOOCs

note: No fact: Paradigm Initiative's six-country report on digital inclusion names no school information system for Algeria; its only school-related statement for the country is distance education, a learning system. Its one use of the study's term SNDECI is Cote d'Ivoire's education strategy.
